plans.idea: Classic landscape split: the square bottle hero fills the left half with the round NEW FLAVOR sticker tucked at its top-right shoulder, and a left-aligned right column reads logo → large two-line headline → CTA, all sharing one left edge.

Message-first mirror: brand, headline and CTA stack on a shared left edge so the eye reads left to right into the product, which sits on the right with the sticker badge at its top-right corner like the original.

Centered triptych: the bottle anchors the middle of the canvas as the focal point, with logo and headline on the left panel and the NEW FLAVOR sticker above the CTA on the right panel, so the frame reads brand/headline → product → offer/action.
